requests.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a square raster sheet of nine separate landmark illustrations for a naive zine concept website.
Canvas and composition: SQUARE canvas divided into an exact 3 by 3 equal invisible grid. Nine independent icons, each centered in its own cell with generous blank warm-cream margins. Leave clean empty cream seams at every cell boundary. Nothing crosses the boundaries. No drawn grid or frames. Low detail; every icon must read clearly when cropped to 100 pixels. Each building is fully contained and distinct. ONLY landmark illustrations, NOT a map, no connecting roads.
Style: naive zine, hand-drawn, slightly awkward and friendly; rough ink-black outlines, simple geometric silhouettes, flat spot-color fills and spare marker grain. Use ONLY warm cream #F7F4EE background, rough ink black #111111, and sky blue #82D6F7.
Exact nine subjects, reading left to right, top to bottom:
Row 1 column 1: an ordinary five-storey Japanese department store beside a small generic station train-front pictogram; no real Daimaru logo.
Row 1 column 2: a lively low-roof Japanese fish market, a few fish crates and fish silhouettes.
Row 1 column 3: a friendly simple aquarium building with a fish motif.
Row 2 column 1: a Shinto torii gate with a modest shrine.
Row 2 column 2: a samurai district house, tiled roof, white earth wall and small tree.
Row 2 column 3: a modern bullet-train station with a small shinkansen nose.
Row 3 column 1: a nostalgic Western-style Japanese port station with a symmetrical tiled roof.
Row 3 column 2: a white Japanese castle with layered roofs, Kokura-inspired but not an exact architectural depiction.
Row 3 column 3: a Shinto gabled main hall with four small roof sections, Sumiyoshi-inspired but not an exact architectural depiction.
Constraints: conceptual recognizable building types rather than documented exact architecture. No written characters of any language, text, numbers, logos, labels, arrows, signs, UI, watermarks, realistic rendering, complex 3D, gradients, shadows or recognizable licensed characters. No people required. All nine separate icons must be contained inside their respective equal cells.

Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a 16:9 raster sheet of four independent evening experience vignettes for a naive zine concept website.
Canvas and composition: WIDE 16:9 canvas, exact 2 by 2 equal invisible grid, producing four equal 16:9 quadrants. Each vignette is centered within its own quadrant with empty warm-cream seams and generous empty outer edges. No drawn frames, no grid, nothing crossing any seam. Distinct scenes that can be cropped cleanly as four separate images.
Style: naive zine, hand-drawn, slightly awkward and friendly Japanese people with dot eyes, simple geometric silhouettes, rough ink-black outlines, flat spot fills, spare marker grain, dignified warm encounters. Use ONLY warm cream #F7F4EE background, ink black #111111, and lavender #C5A6E8.
Top-left quadrant: a Japanese seafood night market. A local chef finishes kawara soba greenish noodles on a roof-tile-shaped dish rendered only in the stated palette; a fish vendor and families at a food counter, with a few small string lamps.
Top-right quadrant: an evening craft workshop and shop. A Japanese artisan helps visitors stamp or personalize cloth with unlettered abstract marks and choose simple ceramics. A warm close encounter across the worktable.
Bottom-left quadrant: people playing an original pufferfish sea-voyage cooperative arcade game using handwheels and unlettered cards. A small cute original pufferfish mascot stands beside the simple game booth. Invent a simple friendly pufferfish design, no existing anime or licensed characters.
Bottom-right quadrant: intimate evening music and participatory theatre. A local duo plays acoustic instruments while a performer offers an unlettered story card to a seated guest.
Mood and constraints: evenings that adults and families can enjoy without alcohol being a requirement. Warm, dignified, playful, not a crowded nightclub. Sparse enough to read at small website sizes. No alcohol emphasis. No written characters, text, numbers, labels, logos, arrows, watermarks, UI, realistic rendering, complex 3D, gradients or shadows. Keep every scene fully inside its own equal quadrant with clean cream separation.

Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one big airy 16:9 hero illustration for a naive zine concept website.
Primary scene: couples and a family strolling along a seaside promenade in the foreground. A small generic ferry on the strait. Distant Japanese town roofs, and a symbolic suspension bridge gently arching in the far background. A large moon and a few warm lanterns. A small cute original pufferfish quietly sits on the low seawall.
Composition: a single coherent wide scene, not panels and not a map. One horizon. Main scene fills the central 80 percent of the width and 70 percent of the height, keeping generous blank warm-cream outer padding. Sea is mostly empty cream negative space with just a few ink waves. Open and airy. The setting can suggest Kanmon without claiming exact geography or a real sightline. Promenade-level view, not a rooftop.
Style: naive zine, hand-drawn and slightly awkward yet friendly, Japanese people with dot eyes, simple geometric silhouettes, rough ink black outlines, flat spot-color fills and spare marker grain.
Color palette: use ONLY warm cream #F7F4EE background, ink black #111111 and lemon yellow #F3DE53. Night is suggested by the moon and warm lanterns while preserving the cream background.
Narrative and mood: sunset becomes night, and you want to stay; relaxed, inviting couples and family, unhurried seaside evening.
Constraints: no photo, realism, complex 3D, gradients, shadows, map symbols, text, numbers, labels, arrows, written signs, logos, UI, watermarks or recognizable licensed characters. No exact architecture or promised sightseeing sightline.
